consequence.statement: Watched resources' .status changes and common mutated resources will be ignored by default, reducing load on Argo CD; this changes behavior from v2.14 where these were processed.
consequence.remediation: If v2 behavior is required, override or remove the resource.customizations.ignoreResourceUpdates configuration in the argocd-cm ConfigMap.

original.statement: Argo CD 3.0.0 adds a default configuration for resource.customizations.ignoreResourceUpdates in the argocd-cm ConfigMap that excludes common mutated resources and always ignores .status changes; the v2 behavior can be preserved by overriding or removing this configuration.

decision.reason: [ev-94989021db77] says 3.0 ships a new default `resource.customizations.ignoreResourceUpdates` in argocd-cm, so `.status` changes and churn from commonly mutated resources are ignored. It also says these defaults "can be overridden or removed in the configMap to preserve the v2 behavior". This is a changed default that keeps working, not a failure, rejection or required migration, so behavior-change (review) is the right kind. The proposed statement and remediation match the evidence. The evidence says nothing about severity, so medium is a judgement call, not something the evidence proves.
